purpose: 선택의 근거 확인이 완전한 조사나 정답 판정이 아니라 결론을 실제로 바꿀 한 사실을 처음 움직여 확인하는 가역적 action-beat 12개 편집 검토안이다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-evidence action-beat guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair and no extra adviser, partner, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one immediate evidence-check action covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Capture only the first fact-token press, lamp switch, criterion lift, sample placement or narrow opening while unverified evidence and a return edge remain visibly separate; never declare a correct choice, certainty, verdict, destiny or guaranteed outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Trays, boards, doors, seals, sockets, bottles and bays remain open, removable, blank or reversible. Libra may use exactly one abstract evidence balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
